events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Carlos Rodón allowed three hits in eight sharp innings and the New York Yankees prevented the Tampa Bay Rays from clinching the AL East title with a 2-0 victory in the opener of a day-night doubleheader on Tuesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rodón allows three hits in eight sharp innings as Yanks beat Rays 2-0 in doubleheader opener

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Zack Wheeler struck 11, including a franchise-record seven in a row to start the game, and Bryson Stott hit a tiebreaking single with two outs in the eighth inning as the Philadelphia Phillies inched closer to clinching a playoff spot with a 6-4...
headlines.shortLinkText: Wheeler fans 7 straight to open game, Stott hits tiebreaking single as Phillies beat Brewers 6-4

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Pittsburgh Pirates

headlines.description: — Jared Jones allowed one hit over seven dominant innings and the Pittsburgh Pirates inched closer to the franchise's first winning season in eight years with a 2-0 win over St. Louis on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jones takes perfect game into the 6th, Pirates top Cardinals 2-0 for 5th straight win

headlines.description: — CJ Abrams hit a tiebreaking two-run homer and added a solo shot to give the Washington Nationals a 3-1 victory over the Detroit Tigers on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: CJ Abrams homers twice, drives in three runs as Nationals beat Tigers 3-1

events.name: Cleveland Guardians at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Nathaniel Lowe had a tiebreaking sacrifice fly off reliever Erik Miller in the ninth inning, and the Cleveland Guardians maintained their slim first-place lead in the AL Central with a 3-2 victory over the Boston Red Sox on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lowe's sacrifice fly breaks tie and lifts Guardians past Red Sox, 3-2, helping them atop AL Central

events.name: Tampa Bay Rays at New York Yankees

headlines.description: — Drew Rasmussen allowed his only hit in the seventh inning and struck out 11 as the Tampa Bay Rays beat the New York Yankees 6-1 on Tuesday in the second game of a day-night doubleheader to clinch their fifth AL East title.
headlines.shortLinkText: Drew Rasmussen takes no-hitter into 7th and Ks 11 as Rays clinch AL East with 6-1 win over Yankees

headlines.description: — Elly De La Cruz closed in on a 30-30 season, Brandon Williamson threw six sharp innings and the Cincinnati Reds blanked the NL East champion Atlanta Braves 4-0 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: De La Cruz closes in on 30-30, Williamson throws six sharp innings as Reds blank Braves 4-0

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — Chase Meidroth hit a three-run homer and had a career-high five RBI, Randal Grichuk added a three-run shot among his four hits, and the Chicago White Sox beat the Kansas City Royals 14-11 on Tuesday night to stay a game behind Cleveland in the AL...
headlines.shortLinkText: Meidroth, Grichuk hit 3-run shots, White Sox beat Royals 14-11 to remain a game back in AL Central

headlines.description: — Griffin Conine drove in Esteury Ruiz with a tiebreaking single in Miami's six-run 12th inning, and the Marlins stymied Chicago's push for an NL wild card with an 8-2 victory over the Cubs on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Miami Marlins stymie Chicago's push for NL wild card with 8-2 victory over the Cubs

events.name: New York Mets at Texas Rangers

headlines.description: — Sean Manaea struck out nine in six innings, Francisco Alvarez doubled and scored twice while driving in two runs, and the New York Mets beat the AL West-leading Texas Rangers 6-3 on Tuesday night in their first game with
headlines.shortLinkText: Mets win 1st game after Andy Green named full-time manager, beating AL West-leading Rangers 6-3

headlines.description: — Nolan Arenado had his team-leading 28th homer of the season among his three hits, Michael Soroka struck out nine in seven innings of one-run ball and the Arizona Diamondbacks beat Colorado 7-2 Tuesday night, sending the Rockies to their 100th loss...
headlines.shortLinkText: Diamondbacks beat Rockies 7-2, send Colorado to its 4th straight season of 100 or more losses

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Athletics Athletics

headlines.description: — Carlos Cortes and Zack Gelof each hit a two-run homer in the eighth inning as the Athletics rallied past the Los Angeles Angels 9-7 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Athletics rally with 2 homers in 8th to complete comeback in 9-7 win over Angels

headlines.description: — Yordan Alvarez resumed his Triple Crown push with a home run and three RBI as the Houston Astros beat the Seattle Mariners 7-0 on Tuesday...
headlines.shortLinkText: Alvarez hits 41st homer and drives in 3 as Astros blank Mariners 7-0 to tie Rangers atop AL West

events.name: Minnesota Twins at San Francisco Giants

headlines.shortLinkText: Bradley passes 200 strikeouts, pitches Twins to 3-2 win over Giants

events.name: San Diego Padres at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Tommy Edman and Will Smith homered as the Los Angeles Dodgers scored six runs with two outs to beat the San Diego Padres 7-0 on Tuesday night in a series opener between rivals with the two best records in the majors this month.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dodgers score 5 two-out runs off Padres starter Michael King in 7-0 victory
